newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer shuts down Latin American unit.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer shuts down Latin American unit.

text.p: Oppenheimer & Co is shutting down its Latin American operations, effective immediately, a senior company official said on Thursday.
"They are basically shutting down equities, sales, trading and research...effective immediately," said Vinod Sehgal, director of Latin American research and an Oppenheimer managing director.
The decision affects 30 professional staffers, including 18 research analysts. The unit covered 85 companies in nine industries.
Sources at the private firm said the decision was made because Oppenheimer was refocusing its effort in Latin America in areas where it could compete and see a greater likelihood of success.
An Oppenheimer spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
